Name: RuneScape Mastercape Back Accessories (Capes) - Tsuyuki
Author: Tsuyukii
Description:
[center]Like in the lands of Geilinor(Runescape), show-off your mastered skills to local farmers, townspeople, and maybe even the girl next door! I'm sure she'll love your modded Stardew Valley Swag(Tm)[/center]

[u][i]This Mod Adds[/i][/u] :
[list]
[*]Mining Mastercape
[*]Attack Mastercape
[*]Cooking Mastercape
[*]Farming Mastercape
[/list]
[u][i]Required Mods[/i][/u] :
[list=1]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Fashion Sense
[/list]
[u][i]TODO (Future Updates)[/i][/u] :[list=1]
[*]Add all trainable Stardew Valley skill Mastercapes, including extras (like the Slayer Mastercape)!
[*]Animate Capes (Including swaying and particle trails that flow behind the end of the cape)
[*]Add Max Skillcape and Completionist Skillcape
[*]Add these as unique quest rewards when mastering a a skill

[/list][u][i]
How To Use[/i][/u] :
﻿Purchase a Hand Mirror from Pierre's General Store and use it. Click on 'Accessories' and scroll through the list until you see the 'RuneScape Mastercapes'
